theorems.name: Submission.support_subset_closedBall_of_radial_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (q : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (R ε : ℝ), 0 < n → 0 ≤ R → 0 < ε → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → IsCompact μ.support → LocallyIntegrableOn H (closedBall ξ R)ᶜ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable q μ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ q x ∧ q x ≤ 1) → ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ γ t ∧ 0 ≤ deriv γ t) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ R + ε → γ t = 0) → (∀ t : ℝ, R + ε < t → 0 < γ t) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ (closedBall ξ R)ᶜ → |inner ℝ (H x) (x - ξ)| < (n : ℝ)) → ∫ x in (closedBall ξ R)ᶜ, ((n : ℝ) * γ ‖x - ξ‖ + ‖x - ξ‖ * deriv γ ‖x - ξ‖ * (1 - q x)) ∂μ = -∫ x in (closedBall ξ R)ᶜ, γ ‖x - ξ‖ * inner ℝ (x - ξ) (H x) ∂μ → μ.support ⊆ closedBall ξ (R + ε)
